For any ε = ε(n, m) > 0, there is an FDO for G with stretch 1 + ε, preprocessing time O(mn), e space o(m), and constant query time. For the sake of readability, the FDOs in Section 3 are randomized. Later, in Section 4, we describe our derandomization framework and show how to apply it to both FDOs.
